description: A distributor tracks how much of each item is in each of its warehouses.
data: items with a stock code (unique) and a name
stock movements: an item received into a warehouse, shipped out of it, or transferred to another warehouse, with a quantity
actions: the manager adds warehouses and items
staff see the warehouses and items
staff see what a warehouse holds
staff see how much of an item there is and where
rules: nothing can be shipped or transferred that the warehouse does not hold
a transfer needs a different destination warehouse
